answer: Anchor each identity to an irreversible proof-of-burn: to join, an agent destroys a modest sum of the network's own token, and the burn receipt binds to one identity forever. At the zenith of demand the registry charges a rising burn for every extra identity the same operator registers, so a clone army's cost climbs in a spiral while honest agents pay once and stand on the ledge of a cheap entry. Burns are public, so anyone can audit what an operator has sunk; a sybil farmer keeps destroying real value per fake voice, with no refund or resale to recover it.
